window.title: Settings
idle.title: Shell
idle.description: Idle timeouts, dock, and bar settings stored in shell.json.
monitors.title: Monitors
monitors.description: Scale, mode, and position for each connected display. Changes apply live and are written to monitors.lua.
input.title: Input
input.description: Touchpad, pointer, and keyboard settings written to input.lua. Custom gestures stay in the preserved section.
input.customNote: This file has custom Lua (gestures, etc.) that the GUI leaves alone.
input.clickfingerDesc: Use two-finger click instead of the lower-right corner.
input.drag3fgDesc: Drag and select with three fingers.
keybindings.title: Keybindings
keybindings.description: All Omarchy defaults plus your overrides. Rebind, unbind, or restore any shortcut; custom binds are written to bindings.lua.
keybindings.label: Label
hyprland.title: Hyprland
hyprland.description: Binding packs and look & feel. Custom Lua (window rules, animation curves) stays preserved.
hyprland.customNote: Custom Lua below the managed sections is preserved on save.
hyprland.defaultBindingsDesc: Turn off to disable every stock binding and define your own in Keybindings.
hyprland.preinstalledBindingsDesc: Bindings for Omarchy's preinstalled apps and web apps.
hyprland.resizeOnBorderDesc: Drag window edges to resize without holding a modifier.
hyprsunset.title: Night light
hyprsunset.description: Hyprsunset schedule from hyprsunset.conf. Day keeps identity (no tint); night optionally warms the display.
hyprsunset.customNote: Custom conf lines below the managed section are preserved.
hyprsunset.nightEnabledDesc: Adds a second profile with a warmer temperature after night start time.
hyprsunset.temperatureDesc: Typical night values are 3000–4500. Lower is warmer.
hyprsunset.gammaDesc: Leave empty for default. 100 is normal.
xdph.title: Screen share
xdph.description: xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland options in xdph.conf. Changes apply on the next portal restart (often next login).
xdph.customNote: Custom conf lines below the managed section are preserved.
xdph.allowTokenDesc: Skip re-prompting for an existing restore token when possible.
